title: ephemerantha dura
intro: Ephemerantha dura, commonly known as the "Dura plant", is a type of flowering plant native to the tropical regions of Asia. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with potential health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial activities, which may aid in the treatment of various diseases. The therapeutic actions of Ephemerantha dura include its ability to reduce inflammation, protect against oxidative stress, and exhibit immunomodulatory effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
